common.save_failed.zh-TW: 暫時無法儲存，請再試一次。
common.save_failed.en: We couldn't save just now. Please try again.

sports.scene.zh-TW: 立體運動場館，可使用下方按鈕切換視角
sports.scene.en: Dimensional sports venue. Use the buttons below to change the view.

sports.detail_0.zh-TW: 選一座場館，換個角度看看海景與器材，想動一動時再開始。
sports.detail_0.en: Choose a venue, explore the sea views and equipment from another angle, and move when you feel like it.

sports.detail_1.zh-TW: 沿著池緣看看海，或輕輕入水，留一點時間給自己。
sports.detail_1.en: Watch the sea from the poolside, or slip into the water and take a moment for yourself.

sports.detail_2.zh-TW: 面海的木質健身房。試試跑步機的輕鬆動作，隨時可以休息。
sports.detail_2.en: A wooden gym facing the sea. Try a gentle treadmill movement and rest whenever you like.

sports.detail_3.zh-TW: 看看球網、場線與海風，試一段短暫的擊球動作。完整對打尚未開放。
sports.detail_3.en: Explore the net and court markings, then try a brief hitting movement. Full matches are not available yet.

sports.detail_4.en: Slip gently into the water and float for a moment.

sports.detail_5.zh-TW: 跟著自己的步調，輕鬆動一動…
sports.detail_5.en: Move gently, at your own pace…

nomad.status.zh-TW: 施工中 · 尚未公布開幕日期
nomad.status.en: Under construction · Opening date not announced

nomad.preview.zh-TW: Nomad House 建築概念預覽

nomad.concept.zh-TW: 建築概念預覽；四個生活區域尚未開放。
nomad.concept.en: Architectural concept preview; the four living areas are not open yet.

nomad.intro.zh-TW: 即使需要工作，也可以在一個溫暖、自在的小世界裡完成。烏布雨林的自然感，與長谷共享工作的自在節奏。
nomad.intro.en: Even when work calls, you can do it in a warm little world. Inspired by the greenery of Ubud and the easy coworking rhythm of Canggu.

nomad.safe.zh-TW: 請留在木圍籬外的步道。工程熊熊正在整理竹材與木平台。
nomad.safe.en: Please stay on the path outside the wooden fence. Our builder is preparing bamboo and a timber deck.

nomad.workCopy.zh-TW: 竹木長桌、藤椅與筆電。以後可以在這裡工作或閱讀。
nomad.workCopy.en: Bamboo tables, rattan chairs and laptops. A future spot to work or read.

nomad.coffeeCopy.zh-TW: 一杯虛擬咖啡，陪你放慢腳步。
nomad.coffeeCopy.en: A virtual coffee to help you slow down.

nomad.deckCopy.zh-TW: 海風、躺椅與綠植，留一個不用努力的角落。
nomad.deckCopy.en: Sea breezes, loungers and greenery. A corner where you can simply be.

nomad.focusCopy.zh-TW: 安靜工作或閱讀；可選的陪伴計時將於後續階段加入。
nomad.focusCopy.en: Work or read quietly. An optional companion timer will follow in a later phase.

nomad.promise.zh-TW: 這裡不需要打卡、排名或完成任務。你也可以只是來待一會。
nomad.promise.en: No check-ins, rankings or tasks. You can simply stay a while.

nomad.hint.zh-TW: 熱帶共享工作屋正在準備中。先看看建築概念，開幕日期尚未公布
nomad.hint.en: A tropical coworking retreat is taking shape. Preview the concept; no opening date has been announced

nomad.structureStatus.zh-TW: 屋架施工中 · 尚未開放入內
nomad.structureStatus.en: Structure taking shape · Not open for entry

nomad.progressImage.zh-TW: Nomad House 屋架施工進度

nomad.progressCaption.zh-TW: 竹屋架與部分茅草屋頂已成形，木平台、藤椅與熱帶綠植正在準備中。
nomad.progressCaption.en: The bamboo frame and partial thatch roof are taking shape. A timber deck, rattan seating and tropical plants are being prepared.

nomad.progressSafety.zh-TW: 步道已連接至施工告示；圍籬內仍在施工，尚未公布開幕日期。
nomad.progressSafety.en: The path leads to the construction sign. Work continues inside the fence; no opening date has been announced.

nomadLive.welcome.zh-TW: 工作、閱讀，或只是和大家待在一起。今天不需要完成任何事。
nomadLive.welcome.en: Work, read, or simply share a little space. There is nothing you have to finish today.

nomadLive.panHelp.zh-TW: 手機可左右滑動場景，或使用區域按鈕找到座位。
nomadLive.panHelp.en: On mobile, swipe across the scene or use the area buttons to find a seat.

nomadLive.choose.en: Choose an empty seat and settle in.

nomadLive.workNote.zh-TW: 竹屋頂下的長桌留著筆電與書本。點空位坐下，再選想做的事。
nomadLive.workNote.en: Laptops and books await beneath the bamboo roof. Choose an empty seat, then do what feels right.

nomadLive.coffeeNote.zh-TW: 沿用海邊咖啡館的虛擬飲品。先取一杯，想喝時再喝一口。
nomadLive.coffeeNote.en: Enjoy the same virtual drinks as the seaside cafe. Pick a cup and take a sip whenever you like.

nomadLive.deckNote.zh-TW: 木露台、藤椅與小水景，陪你伸個懶腰，或什麼都不想。
nomadLive.deckNote.en: A timber deck, rattan chairs and gentle water. Stretch a little or let your mind wander.

nomadLive.focusNote.zh-TW: 獨立座位適合安靜工作或閱讀。可以開啟「減少動畫與聲音」。
nomadLive.focusNote.en: An individual seat for quiet work or reading. Turn on Reduce motion and sound for less distraction.

nomadLive.walking.en: Taking a gentle walk along the aisle…

nomadLive.quietSound.zh-TW: 安靜模式已開啟；環境音保持關閉。
nomadLive.quietSound.en: Quiet mode is on; ambient sound stays off.

nomadLive.audioUnavailable.zh-TW: 目前無法播放環境音，你仍可以安靜地待著。
nomadLive.audioUnavailable.en: Ambient sound is unavailable. You can still enjoy the quiet.

nomad.openHint.zh-TW: 熱帶工作屋開門了。找個座位工作、閱讀、喝咖啡，或在露台放空
nomad.openHint.en: The tropical retreat is open. Find a seat to work, read or have a coffee, or unwind on the deck
